ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_contrastive_advantage_clamped
ir.intuition: To prevent numerical instability from dividing by very small advantage gaps, clamp the absolute advantage gap to a minimum epsilon before inversion. This stabilization avoids excessively large weights for pairs with near-zero advantage gaps. The loss remains a softplus of the negative scaled log-prob difference, preserving smooth contrastive semantics. Clamping enhances stability and smoothness without complicating the formula.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
clamped_adv = clamp(abs(adv_gap), min=1e-3)
l_diff = batch['log_prob_w'] - batch['log_prob_l']
inv_adv = 1 / clamped_adv
score = l_diff * inv_adv
loss = mean(weight * softplus(-score)) if weight else mean(softplus(-score))

hyperparams.family_tags: contrastive, advantage, reciprocal, clamp, smooth, ranking

ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-3  # larger clamp for stability
    abs_adv = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    clamped_adv = ops.clamp(abs_adv, epsilon, None)  # clamp min to epsilon
    inv_adv = ops.div(ops.ones_like(clamped_adv), clamped_adv)
    l_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    score = ops.mul(l_diff, inv_adv)
    neg_score = ops.neg(score)
    loss_vec = ops.softplus(neg_score)
    if weight is not None:
        loss_vec = ops.mul(loss_vec, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss_vec)
